purpose: Core binary: main.go only, exits with app.Main(os.Args[1:])

dedupe: cid + event ack marks) with credential and password redaction; wires components (event reconciler only when RECONCILE_ENABLED); ordered startup and budgeted shutdown (reconciler stops after gRPC, before router; cid batcher starts before the router and drains right after it, before the flusher); small warm Redis pools (dedupe: 2x CID_BATCH_SHARDS + 4 conns, MinIdleConns, no command retries, 1 dial retry; both clients DisableIdentity); gRPC served only after a clean start; metrics_wiring.go registers detectors on the admin /metrics (worker lag/processed/failures and per-effect republished/dropped on every core; reader metrics only with RECONCILE_ENABLED); prepare ensures the work stream after the event stream; effect workers on every core (effects_wiring.go: registry MessageInserted -> room_activity, reply_mention_index, msg_created; RoomInserted -> room_created; EditInserted -> room_activity, edit_projection, reply_mention_index, msg_changed (reply_mention_index runs after edit_projection and before the delayed msg_changed, keeping delays non-decreasing; it gets the Mongo store messages, interactions, mentions and the message count timers as LinkTimers); ReactionChanged -> room_activity, reaction_event, count_event; PinInserted -> room_activity, pin_projection, pin_event (reaction_pin_effects_wiring.go builds the four new effects with their own counter and pin projector); MemberChanged -> room_activity, member_event, member_count_event; ReadChanged -> read_event; MessageHidden -> hidden_event; HistoryCleared -> history_cleared_event; MemberCountCheck -> member_count_repair (member_effects_wiring.go builds the six member effects and their counters; effectSet.registry builds the registry); BookmarkChanged -> room_activity, bookmark_event (built in reaction_pin_effects_wiring.go; grpcsrv gets st.Interactions() as Deps.Bookmarks); work queues nak unknown kinds after WORK_RETRY_DELAY) on a third JetStream client; start after the slot manager, before the reader; stop after the reader, before the router (WORK_DRAIN + 1s); resync subcommand (resync_command.go: Mongo + NATS only, reuses client helpers and redaction; passes the store as members and its hidden messages); recount subcommand (recount_command.go: Mongo + NATS only, same config and redaction; -room required, -dry-run; reads the room, CountMembers, prints room/stored/counted, then SetMemberCount CAS on the member_count_ver read (a miss exits with an error) and publishes member_count_changed waiting for the PubAck); Redis cid dedupe store on the dedupe Redis instance (chatim-redis-dedupe): key chatim:cid:{room}:{user}:{cid}, or chatim:req:{room}:{user}:{request_id} for Key.Space SpaceRequest, or chatim:req:create:{tenant}:{user}:{request_id} for SpaceCreate (CreateKey: Key.Tenant, room 0; its batcher shard comes from an FNV hash of tenant:user, room keys use the slot, D118); batched Lua Reserve (pending p:{core}) / Commit (c:{seq}:{ms}; old 4-field values read as absent) / conditional Abort; degraded mode via redisguard; Batcher batches Reserve/Commit/Abort across rooms per shard (slot % CID_BATCH_SHARDS): Reserve rounds sent as soon as none is in flight (up to MaxKeys), Commit/Abort queued without blocking and flushed on Close; Requests dedupes commands by request_id over any Registry (the Batcher in prod): Begin maps Reserve to RequestNew/RequestDone/RequestBusy and returns the committed Record when done (Redis errors fall back to a RAM LRU of RequestCacheSize records valid until ttl after the command), Finish = Commit + remember, Cancel = Abort

Effect engine workers: one goroutine per work partition that fetches only while this core owns the slot with the same number (checked before every fetch); groups a batch by change kind and runs the kind's effects in registry order, each after max(CommittedAt) + its delay; acks a record when every effect returned nil, else naks it after WORK_RETRY_DELAY; Close stops fetching, lets a running effect finish and hands records still waiting their delay back with Nak(0); undecodable and deferred unknown-kind records count as failures; Stats (processed, failed, lag behind commit + delay); msg_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY): batch ack mark lookup (failure = all unmarked), majority Find of unmarked messages per room, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for every PubAck; missing doc, unknown room or invalid key is dropped and counted; room type cache shared across partitions; room_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Rooms.Get, event rebuilt with pbconv.RoomCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; unknown room dropped and counted; room_activity uses seq 0 for every kind except MessageInserted (edits, reactions and pins bump only the change time and bucket, kept apart from new messages of the same timeline); edit_projection effect (delay 0) for EditInserted (a ver 0 original row returns nil at once): Edits.At, Messages.ApplyEdit (CAS by version), PurgeText below a delete fact; missing fact dropped and counted; msg_changed effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark; skips a ver 0 record without reading): Edits.At, room type cache, Find, refuses (retry) while the projection is behind the fact, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageChanged (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; counts as republished only PubAcks the stream had not deduplicated; missing fact, message or room dropped; count_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, D113) for ReactionChanged: groups the batch by message, one Find per message, publishes counts_changed {room}-{thread}-{seq}-reactions-v{v} of the current rx when v >= 1 (the stream drops the fast-path copy by id), counts only PubAcks the stream had not stored; missing message or room dropped, store errors retry every record of the message; reaction_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Reactions.Get, publishes reaction_changed only when the doc change number equals the record (newer doc skips, older doc = ErrStaleRead retry), missing doc or room dropped; pin_projection effect (delay 0) for PinInserted: one pinproj Project per room up to the newest pin version of the batch, missing room dropped, other errors retry every record of the room; pin_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Pins.At(room, pv), Find, pbconv.PinChanged (deleted message without text); missing fact, message or room dropped; eventPublisher shares the publish loop, room type cache and counters of the new event effects; groupRecords groups record indexes by key; member effects (memberEffect shares setup, current doc lookup and drop rules): member_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) MembersOf(room,[user]) publishes pbconv.MemberEvent only when the doc ver equals the record (newer doc skips, older = ErrStaleRead retry, nil event = nothing), missing doc or room dropped; member_count_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) one Rooms.Get per room per batch, publishes member_count_changed of the stored count when member_count_ver >= 1 (actor empty), missing room drops every record of the room; read_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for ReadChanged republishes read_updated when read_ver equals the record; hidden_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for MessageHidden reads Hidden.Get and publishes message_hidden at the hide time, missing hide dropped; history_cleared_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for HistoryCleared publishes history_cleared of the current cleared_at, never cleared or missing member dropped; member_count_repair (delay 0) for MemberCountCheck timer records: one per room per batch, Rooms.Get then CountMembers; equal = republish member_count_changed of the stored count and ver (ver >= 1; covers a lost PubAck), no write and no timer; else arm a follow-up work.Timers timer first (arm failure = nak, nothing written; the timer is never disarmed so a command in flight at CAS time is recounted after MEMBER_COUNT_CHECK_DELAY), then SetMemberCount CAS on member_count_ver (miss = ErrRetryLater nak), counts Repaired (counter members), publishes member_count_changed and waits for the PubAck; missing room dropped; no loops; room type cache also keeps the room tenant (identity) for events built from a room; count_repair (CountRepair, delay 0, kind MessageCountCheck): per (message, counter) Find the message, recount (CountReactions or CountLiveReplies), equal count republishes counts_changed only when v >= 1, else arms a follow-up ArmMessageCountCheck before the CAS (SetReactions on rx.v or SetReplyCount on rc.v; miss = ErrRetryLater nak), counts Repaired(reactions|replies) and publishes counts_changed (-reactions-v{v} or -replies-v{v}); missing message or room dropped; bookmark_event (BookmarkEvent, delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark) for BookmarkChanged after room_activity: GetBookmark, publishes bookmark_changed (pbconv.BookmarkChanged, fast path parity) only when the doc ver equals the record (newer doc skips, older = ErrStaleRead retry), missing doc or room dropped; reply_mention_index effect (delay 0, D114, D115) for MessageInserted and EditInserted: only records with flags (MessageInserted Version = ReplyMentionFlags) or an edit ver >= 1 are read, one Find per room per batch; reply (insert record with HasReply, or edit record of a deleted message with reply_to): ArmMessageCountCheck(parent, replies) -> AddReply (live message) or RemoveReply (deleted) -> only on a real change AddReplyCount(+1/-1) -> counts_changed {room}-{thread}-{seq}-replies-v{v} (PubAck awaited) -> Disarm; no change = Disarm only; a count or publish failure keeps the timer and Naks; a vanished parent or room is dropped and disarmed; mentions (insert record with HasMention, every edit record): Mentions.ApplyMentions of the current message (targets from MentionTargetsOf, none when deleted) at messages.v; missing message dropped; errors per record Nak; eventPublisher.publishOne

Event ack marks on the dedupe Redis: bitmap chatim:evtack:{room}:{thread}:{seq>>13}, one bit per message; pipelined SETBIT per key plus PEXPIRE (EVT_ACK_MARK_TTL, 1h) only for chunks not refreshed within TTL/4 (refreshLog in RAM, cleared at 65536 chunks; a failed pipeline records nothing) and GETBIT lookups; degraded mode via redisguard (a lost mark only costs a republish)
Sharded batching flusher: groups from many rooms into one insertMany per Window/MaxBatch; one insert in flight per shard; per-group Deadline (not sent -> ErrNotSent); results split per group

CoreService handlers CreateRoom/OpenDirectRoom/SendMessage/GetHistory/EditMessage/DeleteMessage/HideMessage/ClearHistory/GetEditHistory/ReactMessage/PinMessage/UnpinMessage/GetReactionSettings/SetBookmark/ListBookmarks/GetReplies; caller identity from x-chatim-tenant/x-chatim-user metadata; SendMessage builds the actor command in send_links.go: forward_from goes through forward.go (D116: forward_from with reply_to, a thread source, seq 0 or a bad room id = INVALID_ARGUMENT; Checker.Admit forward_message on the source room (missing room or other tenant = NotFound, non-member = PermissionDenied), Find of the source (missing = NotFound), cleared by the caller (created_at <= member cleared_at) or hidden by the caller (Hidden.Get) = NotFound, deleted = FailedPrecondition, then the policy with the source author and kind; the command carries the source current text, no mentions (client text and mentions dropped) and Forward = the source fw when it is itself a forward, else the source room/thread/seq/author/sent time; 4 key reads), reply_to is checked before the actor (a reply with thread_root != 0 is INVALID_ARGUMENT before any read, ValidateReply, then one Find of the parent on the main timeline: found = go on, the actor checks membership; missing = Checker.Admit send_message first, so a non-member never learns whether a seq exists, then NotFound; a deleted parent is allowed), no store read when reply_to is absent; mentions and @all mapped by pbconv and checked in the actor; CreateRoom (create_room.go, D118): groups only (DM = INVALID_ARGUMENT), request_id required (ValidCID), rejects more than mutate.Mutator.MemberBatch raw members (ErrTooManyMembers, before NewRoom, D107), one random id, then Requests.Begin on dedupe.CreateKey: done = the stored room of Record.Seq, finished first by a resume ensureRoom (accepts its own room duplicate: same tenant, type and creator) for founders with no member doc yet (removed founders keep their tombstone), busy = UNAVAILABLE, new = ensureRoom with Finish (Record.Seq = room id) right after InsertRoom, Cancel only when nothing was inserted (arm failure, taken id = UNAVAILABLE, no redraw); OpenDirectRoom (direct_room.go, D117): NewDirectRoom checks (yourself = INVALID_ARGUMENT), policy open_direct, DirectRooms.Claim with a fresh id, the room with both members active = {room, created false}, else ensureRoom = {room, created true}; a room id held by another room (other tenant or dm_key) = Repoint the claim to a fresh id (a lost CAS logged at Debug) and UNAVAILABLE; room_ensure.go ensureRoom (rerunnable): arm the member count timer (failure = UNAVAILABLE) -> Rooms.InsertRoom (member_count 0, no ver; duplicate: same tenant and dm_key = go on, else errRoomIDTaken + disarm) -> RoomMembers.AddMembers with request_id {room}-created and Join.Owner = the group creator -> AddMemberCount(changed) then disarm (failure logged, timer kept) -> the room re-read when the count was not written here -> when inserted or changed: one batch room_created (with the settled count), member_added of every doc (pbconv.MemberEvent, D104), member_count_changed {room}-members-v{ver} (v1 on a clean create) on the publisher (fast path; a refused enqueue is not retried); GetHistory reads the store directly with tenant and membership checks; change RPCs are thin calls into mutate.Mutator (callerAndRoom parses caller and room id); GetEditHistory checks the key and limit (PageLimit); admits (access ReadEditHistory), finds the message (missing = NotFound), asks the policy with the message author, deleted = no versions; Edits.History after after_ver, an empty page = no versions, a newest fact of kind delete (last row of a short page, else Edits.Latest) = no versions before its projection lands, on the first page (after_ver 0) the ver 0 original row (Edits.At) goes first when present, mapped by pbconv.MessageVersions; Deps requires Mutator/Edits/Hidden/Bookmarks/Members/Timers/Requests/Directs; PageReader has Page and Find; GetHistory builds the view.Viewer from the member's cleared_at and one Hidden.HiddenIn over the page's seq range (skipped for an empty page or when its newest message is cleared); ClearHistory returns cleared_at; ReactMessage returns the change number and the reaction counts (pbconv.ReactionSummary), PinMessage/UnpinMessage return the pin version and the current pins (pbconv.Pins); all three are thin calls into mutate (react_pin.go); GetHistory returns Message.reactions (counts per emoji only, own emoji is M3) except on deleted or hidden placeholders; GetReactionSettings (reaction_settings.go, not room-routed) requires the caller metadata and returns mutate.Mutator.ReactionEmojis (REACTION_EMOJIS, D95); member RPCs (members.go) AddMembers (added users with their ver), RemoveMember, LeaveRoom (new_owner = MemberResult.Successor), ChangeMemberRole (role mapped by pbconv.DomainMemberRole after the caller check; previous_role) and SetMemberPriority (previous_priority) and read RPCs (read.go) MarkRead/MarkUnread (read_seq, read_ver) are thin calls into mutate after callerAndRoom; SetBookmark (bookmarks.go) is a thin call into mutate (changed); ListBookmarks: caller from metadata, opaque before cursor (bookmark_cursor.go: base64url of 8B big-endian updated_at unix ms + 24B message key; bad base64, length, zero time or invalid key = INVALID_ARGUMENT), limit by PageLimit (default 50, max 100), one BookmarkLister.Bookmarks page (newest first), then per (room, thread) group one Authorize read_history (denied/not found = every item of the group unavailable, no message read), one PageReader.Find of the group keys and viewerOf (cleared_at + one HiddenIn);
